calculation.description: At each date, rank the negative ten-session return trend normalized by twenty-session own-asset volatility. Multiply by lagged cross-asset return dispersion relative to its lagged 252-session median, clipped to avoid extreme regime leverage. All inputs are lagged one completed session. Higher values indicate stronger reversal opportunity, with reversal emphasized during elevated dispersion.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample and recent ICIR across the synthetic 2020-2034 sample; uncertainty is material because the cross-section averages 11.0 and is normally 15 instruments. Elevated-dispersion conditioning improves the medium-horizon reversal signal.
